opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition fee support, and meeting UK residency or asylum status criteria.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition fee support of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students enrolled at Scottish higher education institutions.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented students from low‑income Scottish households who are graduates seeking postgraduate master’s study.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year to support postgraduate master’s programmes for eligible graduates.
